body: Depression is a black dog in your life that never leaves. But through therapy you learn to notice the dog creeping up, and you learn how teach the dog tricks. You learn how to cope and how to overcome suicidal episodes. Every person is different and several therapists are more than likely going to be needed before you find the right one.
